entry.name: notequals
entry.description: Compares two values to see if one value is not equal to a second. Outputs a 1 if the number is not equal to the comparison-number or 0 if it is equal to it.

arguments.name: initial-comparison-value
arguments.description: Sets the initial value, to be compared with a number received in the left inlet. A float argument forces a float comparison.

attributes.name: fuzzy
attributes.digest: Fuzzy floating-point comparison epsilon
attributes.description: When non-zero, an epsilon value to use for fuzzy floating-point comparison. Note that this isn't an absolute tolerance value, but is scaled to accommodate relative error for very large and very small values. The wordcan be used to denote the systemvalue.When zero (default), standard floating-point comparison is used, which may cause apparently equal numbers to not be detected as such.Theattribute is only available in floating-point mode (when the object is instantiated with a floating-point argument).

messages.name: bang
messages.digest: Perform the comparison with the most recent values
messages.description: In left inlet: Performs the comparison with the numbers currently stored. If there is no argument,initially holdsfor comparison.

messages.name: float
messages.digest: Compare to the stored value, cause output
messages.description: Converted tobefore comparison, unlesshas a float argument.

messages.name: in1
messages.description: In right inlet: The number is stored, to be compared with a number received in the left inlet.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Compare to the stored value, cause output
messages.description: In left inlet: The number is compared with the number in the right inlet. If the two numbers are not equal,outputs. If they are equaloutputs.

messages.name: list
messages.description: In left inlet: Compares first and second number, outputs 1 if they are not equal, 0 if they are equal.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Set the incoming value without output
messages.description: Sets the number to be compared without causing output (will output it).
